7a4f04dad6d30ba09c406837cdd23ad779a69210	2026-09-03T20:30:26+08:00	packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds

diff --git a/packaging/abseil-cpp.spec b/packaging/abseil-cpp.spec
index 413f589..951b351 100644
--- a/packaging/abseil-cpp.spec
+++ b/packaging/abseil-cpp.spec
@@ -15,6 +15,11 @@
 # Please submit bugfixes or comments via https://bugs.opensuse.org/
 #
 
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
 
 Name:           abseil-cpp
 Version:        20250814.1
@@ -24,6 +29,10 @@ License:        Apache-2.0
 URL:            https://abseil.io/
 Source0:        %{name}-%{version}.tar.gz
 BuildRequires:  cmake
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 Abseil is a collection of C++11 libraries which augment the C++
@@ -45,6 +54,10 @@ This package contains headers and build system files for it.
 %build
 mkdir -p cmake/build
 cd cmake/build
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 %{cmake} -DABSL_USE_GOOGLETEST_HEAD=OFF ../..
 make %{?_smp_mflags}

    packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
    
    Use libc++ only when the Base Toolchain selector resolves to Clang.
    Keep GCC and non-toolchain builds on their existing standard library.
    
    在 Base Toolchain 选择 Clang 时使用 libc++；GCC 与非工具链构建保持原行为。
